configurePresets.name: clang-tidy
configurePresets.description: Reconfigures the Release build tree generated by 'uv sync' with CMAKE_CXX_CLANG_TIDY enabled so that cmake --build reruns every translation unit through clang-tidy. Run 'uv sync --all-extras' first, then 'cmake --preset clang-tidy && cmake --build --preset clang-tidy'.

configurePresets.name: skbuild-release
configurePresets.description: Adopt the Release build tree generated by 'uv sync' / scikit-build-core. This project only configures correctly through scikit-build-core (which injects SKBUILD, Python and nanobind cache variables from an ephemeral build-isolation environment). Do NOT reconfigure this preset from CMake Tools; run 'uv sync --all-extras' to (re)generate the tree, then use this preset only to build and run the C++ CTest suite.

configurePresets.name: skbuild-debug
configurePresets.description: Adopt the Debug build tree generated by 'uv sync --config-settings=cmake.build-type=Debug' (the 'Install in Debug mode' task). Do NOT reconfigure this preset from CMake Tools; regenerate the tree with uv/scikit-build-core, then use this preset only to build and run the C++ CTest suite.

buildPresets.name: clang-tidy
buildPresets.displayName: clang-tidy static analysis - Build with clang-tidy
buildPresets.description: Rebuilds all translation units in the Release tree with clang-tidy running on each one. Requires the clang-tidy configure preset to have been applied first.

buildPresets.name: skbuild-release
buildPresets.description: Build the C++ unit test executable in the scikit-build-core Release tree. Requires the tree to already exist (run 'uv sync --all-extras').

buildPresets.name: skbuild-debug
buildPresets.description: Build the C++ unit test executable in the scikit-build-core Debug tree. Requires the tree to already exist (run the 'Install in Debug mode' task).

testPresets.name: skbuild-release
testPresets.description: Run the C++ CTest suite from the scikit-build-core Release tree.

testPresets.name: skbuild-debug
testPresets.description: Run the C++ CTest suite from the scikit-build-core Debug tree.
